private fun subtract(root: TaintNode, t: TaintTree, others: List<TaintTree>,
                         protectedOnly: Boolean): TaintNode? {
        val alg = m.taintAlg
        var remaining = root
        for (stored in others) {
            m.cancellation.checkpoint()
            val storedRoot = if (protectedOnly) stored.nonSubsumable ?: continue else stored.root
            val storedMay = stored.anyTail == Tail.ANY
            val storedStar = stored.anyTail == Tail.STAR
            val coversAny = storedMay || stored.anyTail == t.anyTail
            val anyAt = coversAny && (storedMay || stored.exclusion.isSubsetOf(t.exclusion))
            remaining = alg.subtract(remaining, storedRoot, TaintLeaves.EMPTY,
                at = { alg.leaves(if (storedMay) it.exact + it.any else it.exact,
                    if (anyAt) it.any else MarkSet.EMPTY) },
                below = { alg.leaves(if (storedMay) it.any else MarkSet.EMPTY,
                    if (coversAny && !storedStar) it.any else MarkSet.EMPTY) },
                admits = stored.exclusion::admits,
                cancellation = m.cancellation) ?: return null

package org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi

import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.fixtures.DriverFixtures
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.graph.PortId

/** External observer only. No C2/near/intersect calls and no demand or store mutation. */
internal object SharedLoopAllMethodsFrozenCapture {
    private const val ROW_CAP = 4096
    private const val CHAR_CAP = 1048576
    private const val NODE_CAP = 32768
    private fun field(owner: Any, name: String): Any? = owner.javaClass.getDeclaredField(name).run {
        isAccessible = true
        get(owner)
    }
    private inline fun event(stage: String, ap: ApManager, write: LoopPipelineTrace.Fields.() -> Unit) {
        try {
            val fields = LoopPipelineTrace.Fields(CHAR_CAP, NODE_CAP)
            fields.catalog(ap)
            fields.text("schema", "shared-loop-all-methods-frozen-state-v1")
            fields.text("stage", stage)
            fields.flag("wholeSnapshot", true)
            fields.write()
            val line = fields.finish()
            check(line.length <= CHAR_CAP)
            println("BIDI_SHARED_LOOP_FROZEN_SNAPSHOT $line")
        } catch (error: Exception) {
            println("BIDI_SHARED_LOOP_FROZEN_DROP stage=$stage reason=${error.javaClass.name} wholeSnapshotInvalid=true")
        }
    }
    private fun LoopPipelineTrace.Fields.control(prefix: String, value: PairedDemand) {
        when (val entry = value.entry) {
            is DemandEntry.Data -> { text("$prefix.entryKind", "DATA"); pattern("$prefix.entry", entry.pattern) }
            DemandEntry.Zero -> text("$prefix.entryKind", "ZERO")
            DemandEntry.Target -> text("$prefix.entryKind", "TARGET")
        }
        when (val exit = value.exit) {
            is DemandExit.Data -> { text("$prefix.exitKind", "DATA"); pattern("$prefix.exit", exit.pattern) }
            DemandExit.Zero -> text("$prefix.exitKind", "ZERO")
        }
    }

    /** Direct field reads retain every scoped DATA/CONTROL pair and its exact row port. */
    @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
    fun incomingF3(config: RunConfig, root: MethodKey, ap: ApManager) = event("F3_INCOMING_FROZEN_SCOPED_DEMAND", ap) {
        check(config.index == 3)
        val demand = checkNotNull(config.demand)
        check(!demand.hasStaticCompletion && !demand.hasSharedStaticCarry)
        val source = field(demand, "scoped") as Map<OwnedScope, Any>
        val scopes = source.entries.filter { it.key.method == root }
            .sortedWith(compareBy({ it.key.local.block.ordinal }, { it.key.local.entry.ordinal }))
        var total = 0
        var alPresent = false
        number("run", config.index)
        text("method", root.toString())
        flag("hasStaticCompletion", demand.hasStaticCompletion)
        flag("hasSharedStaticCarry", demand.hasSharedStaticCarry)
        flag("publicRowsNotEnumerated", true)
        flag("scopeViewDoesNotBorrowPublicRows", true)
        number("scopeCount", scopes.size)
        for ((scopeIndex, pair) in scopes.withIndex()) {
            val owner = pair.key
            val index = pair.value
            val data = checkNotNull(field(index, "data"))
            val rows = field(data, "rows") as List<DemandPattern>
            val ports = field(index, "rowPorts") as List<PortId>
            val controls = field(index, "controls") as List<Pair<PortId, PairedDemand>>
            check(rows.size == ports.size)
            total += rows.size + controls.size
            check(total <= ROW_CAP)
            val prefix = "scope.$scopeIndex"
            text("$prefix.owner", owner.toString())
            number("$prefix.block", owner.local.block.ordinal)
            number("$prefix.entryPort", owner.local.entry.ordinal)
            val al = root.toString() == "Loop direct T observer root [context]" &&
                owner.local.block.ordinal == 3 && owner.local.entry.ordinal == 7
            flag("$prefix.historicalALLabel", al)
            alPresent = alPresent || al
            number("$prefix.dataCount", rows.size)
            for ((rowIndex, row) in rows.withIndex()) {
                val label = "$prefix.data.$rowIndex"
                number("$label.exitPort", ports[rowIndex].ordinal)
                pattern("$label.entry", row.entry)
                flag("$label.exitIsNull", row.exit == null)
                row.exit?.let { pattern("$label.exit", it) }
            }
            number("$prefix.controlCount", controls.size)
            for ((rowIndex, row) in controls.withIndex()) {
                val label = "$prefix.control.$rowIndex"
                number("$label.exitPort", row.first.ordinal)
                control(label, row.second)
            }
        }
        number("totalScopedRows", total)
        flag("historicalALScopePresent", alPresent)
        flag("completeScopedDataAndControlRows", true)
    }

    /** Authoritative final native stores after the engine has joined/frozen. */
    fun joinedB2(result: RunResult<RunMethodAnalyzer>, root: MethodKey, ap: ApManager) = event("B2_JOINED_SUMMARIES", ap) {
        check(result.runIndex == 2 && result.status == RunStatus.COMPLETE)
        val actor = result.analyzers.singleOrNull { it.key == root }
        flag("analyzerPresent", actor != null)
        if (actor == null) {
            number("run", result.runIndex)
            text("method", root.toString())
            number("scopedSummaryCount", 0)
            number("publicRowCount", 0)
            number("totalRows", 0)
            flag("completeFrozenSummaryRows", true)
            return@event
        }
        val scoped = actor.blockSummaries().toList()
        var total = 0
        number("run", result.runIndex)
        text("method", root.toString())
        number("scopedSummaryCount", scoped.size)
        for ((scopeIndex, summary) in scoped.withIndex()) {
            val rows = summary.summaries.all().toList()
            total += rows.size
            check(total <= ROW_CAP)
            val prefix = "summary.$scopeIndex"
            val next = summary.key.reversed()
            text("$prefix.producerKey", summary.key.toString())
            text("$prefix.nextKey", next.toString())
            number("$prefix.producerBlock", summary.key.scope.block.ordinal)
            number("$prefix.producerEntry", summary.key.scope.entry.ordinal)
            number("$prefix.producerExit", summary.key.exit.ordinal)
            number("$prefix.nextBlock", next.scope.block.ordinal)
            number("$prefix.nextEntry", next.scope.entry.ordinal)
            number("$prefix.nextExit", next.exit.ordinal)
            number("$prefix.rowCount", rows.size)
            for ((rowIndex, row) in rows.withIndex()) {
                val label = "$prefix.row.$rowIndex"
                premise("$label.P", row.first)
                facts("$label.F", row.second)
                flag("$label.selectedForHandoff", selectedForHandoff(row.first, row.second.layer, Direction.BACKWARD))
            }
        }
        val public = actor.summaries.all().toList()
        total += public.size
        check(total <= ROW_CAP)
        number("publicRowCount", public.size)
        for ((index, row) in public.withIndex()) {
            premise("public.$index.P", row.first)
            facts("public.$index.F", row.second)
        }
        number("totalRows", total)
        flag("completeFrozenSummaryRows", true)
    }

    /** This is a processed-input sequence, explicitly not a post-point admission log. */
    fun processedB2(fixture: DriverFixtures, root: MethodKey) = event("B2_PROCESSED_INPUT_HISTORY", fixture.manager) {
        val rows = fixture.processed.filter { it.run == 2 && it.method == root }
        check(rows.size <= ROW_CAP)
        number("run", 2)
        text("method", root.toString())
        number("rowCount", rows.size)
        flag("scopeNotRecorded", true)
        flag("notAStoreAdmissionHistory", true)
        for ((index, row) in rows.withIndex()) {

/** External observer only. No C2/near/intersect calls and no demand or store mutation. */
internal object SharedLoopAllMethodsFrozenCapture {
    private const val ROW_CAP = 4096
    private const val CHAR_CAP = 1048576
    private const val NODE_CAP = 32768
    private fun field(owner: Any, name: String): Any? = owner.javaClass.getDeclaredField(name).run {
        isAccessible = true
        get(owner)
    }
    private inline fun event(stage: String, ap: ApManager, write: LoopPipelineTrace.Fields.() -> Unit) {
        try {
            val fields = LoopPipelineTrace.Fields(CHAR_CAP, NODE_CAP)
            fields.catalog(ap)
            fields.text("schema", "shared-loop-all-methods-frozen-state-v2")
            fields.text("stage", stage)
            fields.flag("wholeSnapshot", true)
            fields.write()
            val line = fields.finish()
            check(line.length <= CHAR_CAP)
            println("BIDI_SHARED_LOOP_FROZEN_SNAPSHOT $line")
        } catch (error: Exception) {
            println("BIDI_SHARED_LOOP_FROZEN_DROP stage=$stage reason=${error.javaClass.name} wholeSnapshotInvalid=true")
        }
    }
    private fun LoopPipelineTrace.Fields.control(prefix: String, value: PairedDemand) {
        when (val entry = value.entry) {
            is DemandEntry.Data -> { text("$prefix.entryKind", "DATA"); pattern("$prefix.entry", entry.pattern) }
            DemandEntry.Zero -> text("$prefix.entryKind", "ZERO")
            DemandEntry.Target -> text("$prefix.entryKind", "TARGET")
        }
        when (val exit = value.exit) {
            is DemandExit.Data -> { text("$prefix.exitKind", "DATA"); pattern("$prefix.exit", exit.pattern) }
            DemandExit.Zero -> text("$prefix.exitKind", "ZERO")
        }
    }

    /** Direct field reads retain every scoped DATA/CONTROL pair and its exact row port. */
    @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
    fun incomingF3(config: RunConfig, root: MethodKey, ap: ApManager) = event("F3_INCOMING_FROZEN_METHOD_AND_SCOPED_DEMAND", ap) {
        check(config.index == 3)
        val demand = checkNotNull(config.demand)
        check(!demand.hasStaticCompletion && !demand.hasSharedStaticCarry)
        val publicIndex = (field(demand, "byMethod") as Map<MethodKey, Any>)[root]
        val publicRows = publicIndex?.let { field(it, "rows") as List<DemandPattern> }.orEmpty()
        val publicControls = (field(demand, "controls") as Map<MethodKey, List<PairedDemand>>)[root].orEmpty()
        check(publicRows.size + publicControls.size <= ROW_CAP)
        flag("publicMethodIndexPresent", publicIndex != null)
        number("publicDataCount", publicRows.size)
        for ((rowIndex, row) in publicRows.withIndex()) {
            val label = "publicDemand.$rowIndex"
            pattern("$label.entry", row.entry)
            flag("$label.exitIsNull", row.exit == null)
            row.exit?.let { pattern("$label.exit", it) }
        }
        number("publicControlCount", publicControls.size)
        for ((rowIndex, row) in publicControls.withIndex()) control("publicControl.$rowIndex", row)
        flag("completePublicDataAndControlRows", true)
        val source = field(demand, "scoped") as Map<OwnedScope, Any>
        val scopes = source.entries.filter { it.key.method == root }
            .sortedWith(compareBy({ it.key.local.block.ordinal }, { it.key.local.entry.ordinal }))
        var total = publicRows.size + publicControls.size
        var alPresent = false
        number("run", config.index)
        text("method", root.toString())
        flag("hasStaticCompletion", demand.hasStaticCompletion)
        flag("hasSharedStaticCarry", demand.hasSharedStaticCarry)
        flag("publicRowsNotEnumerated", false)
        flag("publicRowsEnumeratedDirectly", true)
        flag("scopeViewDoesNotBorrowPublicRows", true)
        number("scopeCount", scopes.size)
        for ((scopeIndex, pair) in scopes.withIndex()) {
            val owner = pair.key
            val index = pair.value
            val data = checkNotNull(field(index, "data"))
            val rows = field(data, "rows") as List<DemandPattern>
            val ports = field(index, "rowPorts") as List<PortId>
            val controls = field(index, "controls") as List<Pair<PortId, PairedDemand>>
            check(rows.size == ports.size)
            total += rows.size + controls.size
            check(total <= ROW_CAP)
            val prefix = "scope.$scopeIndex"
            text("$prefix.owner", owner.toString())
            number("$prefix.block", owner.local.block.ordinal)
            number("$prefix.entryPort", owner.local.entry.ordinal)
            val al = root.toString() == "Loop direct T observer root [context]" &&
                owner.local.block.ordinal == 3 && owner.local.entry.ordinal == 7
            flag("$prefix.historicalALLabel", al)
            alPresent = alPresent || al
            number("$prefix.dataCount", rows.size)
            for ((rowIndex, row) in rows.withIndex()) {
                val label = "$prefix.data.$rowIndex"
                number("$label.exitPort", ports[rowIndex].ordinal)
                pattern("$label.entry", row.entry)
                flag("$label.exitIsNull", row.exit == null)
                row.exit?.let { pattern("$label.exit", it) }
            }
            number("$prefix.controlCount", controls.size)
            for ((rowIndex, row) in controls.withIndex()) {
                val label = "$prefix.control.$rowIndex"
                number("$label.exitPort", row.first.ordinal)
                control(label, row.second)
            }
        }
        number("totalScopedRows", total - publicRows.size - publicControls.size)
        number("totalMethodAndScopedRows", total)
        flag("historicalALScopePresent", alPresent)
        flag("completeScopedDataAndControlRows", true)
    }

    /** Authoritative final native stores after the engine has joined/frozen. */
    fun joinedB2(result: RunResult<RunMethodAnalyzer>, root: MethodKey, ap: ApManager) = event("B2_JOINED_SUMMARIES", ap) {
        check(result.runIndex == 2 && result.status == RunStatus.COMPLETE)
        val actor = result.analyzers.singleOrNull { it.key == root }
        flag("analyzerPresent", actor != null)
        if (actor == null) {
            number("run", result.runIndex)
            text("method", root.toString())
            number("scopedSummaryCount", 0)
            number("publicRowCount", 0)
            number("totalRows", 0)
            flag("completeFrozenSummaryRows", true)
            return@event
        }
        val scoped = actor.blockSummaries().toList()
        var total = 0
        number("run", result.runIndex)
        text("method", root.toString())
        number("scopedSummaryCount", scoped.size)
        for ((scopeIndex, summary) in scoped.withIndex()) {
            val rows = summary.summaries.all().toList()
            total += rows.size
            check(total <= ROW_CAP)
            val prefix = "summary.$scopeIndex"
            val next = summary.key.reversed()
            text("$prefix.producerKey", summary.key.toString())
            text("$prefix.nextKey", next.toString())
            number("$prefix.producerBlock", summary.key.scope.block.ordinal)
            number("$prefix.producerEntry", summary.key.scope.entry.ordinal)
            number("$prefix.producerExit", summary.key.exit.ordinal)
            number("$prefix.nextBlock", next.scope.block.ordinal)
            number("$prefix.nextEntry", next.scope.entry.ordinal)
            number("$prefix.nextExit", next.exit.ordinal)
            number("$prefix.rowCount", rows.size)
            for ((rowIndex, row) in rows.withIndex()) {
                val label = "$prefix.row.$rowIndex"
                premise("$label.P", row.first)
                facts("$label.F", row.second)
                flag("$label.selectedForHandoff", selectedForHandoff(row.first, row.second.layer, Direction.BACKWARD))
            }
        }
        val public = actor.summaries.all().toList()
        total += public.size
        check(total <= ROW_CAP)
        number("publicRowCount", public.size)
        for ((index, row) in public.withIndex()) {
            premise("public.$index.P", row.first)
            facts("public.$index.F", row.second)
        }
        number("totalRows", total)
        flag("completeFrozenSummaryRows", true)
    }

    /** This is a processed-input sequence, explicitly not a post-point admission log. */
    fun processedB2(fixture: DriverFixtures, root: MethodKey) = event("B2_PROCESSED_INPUT_HISTORY", fixture.manager) {
        val rows = fixture.processed.filter { it.run == 2 && it.method == root }
        check(rows.size <= ROW_CAP)
        number("run", 2)
        text("method", root.toString())
        number("rowCount", rows.size)
        flag("scopeNotRecorded", true)
        flag("notAStoreAdmissionHistory", true)
        for ((index, row) in rows.withIndex()) {
            number("processed.$index.node", row.delta.node.location.index)
            premise("processed.$index.P", row.delta.premise)
            facts("processed.$index.F", row.delta.facts)
        }
    }

    fun joinedF3(result: RunResult<RunMethodAnalyzer>, root: MethodKey, ap: ApManager) = event("F3_JOINED_SUMMARIES", ap) {
        check(result.runIndex == 3 && result.status == RunStatus.COMPLETE)
        val actor = result.analyzers.singleOrNull { it.key == root }
        flag("analyzerPresent", actor != null)
        if (actor == null) {
            number("run", result.runIndex)
            text("method", root.toString())
            number("scopedSummaryCount", 0)
            number("publicRowCount", 0)
            number("totalRows", 0)
            flag("completeFrozenSummaryRows", true)
            return@event
        }
        val scoped = actor.blockSummaries().toList()
        var total = 0
        number("run", result.runIndex)
        text("method", root.toString())
        number("scopedSummaryCount", scoped.size)
        for ((scopeIndex, summary) in scoped.withIndex()) {
            val rows = summary.summaries.all().toList()
            total += rows.size
            check(total <= ROW_CAP)
            val prefix = "summary.$scopeIndex"
            val next = summary.key.reversed()
            text("$prefix.producerKey", summary.key.toString())
            text("$prefix.nextKey", next.toString())
            number("$prefix.producerBlock", summary.key.scope.block.ordinal)
            number("$prefix.producerEntry", summary.key.scope.entry.ordinal)
            number("$prefix.producerExit", summary.key.exit.ordinal)
            number("$prefix.nextBlock", next.scope.block.ordinal)
            number("$prefix.nextEntry", next.scope.entry.ordinal)
            number("$prefix.nextExit", next.exit.ordinal)
            number("$prefix.rowCount", rows.size)
            for ((rowIndex, row) in rows.withIndex()) {
                val label = "$prefix.row.$rowIndex"
                premise("$label.P", row.first)
                facts("$label.F", row.second)
                flag("$label.selectedForHandoff", selectedForHandoff(row.first, row.second.layer, Direction.FORWARD))
            }
        }
        val public = actor.summaries.all().toList()
        total += public.size
        check(total <= ROW_CAP)
        number("publicRowCount", public.size)
        for ((index, row) in public.withIndex()) {
            premise("public.$index.P", row.first)
            facts("public.$index.F", row.second)
            flag("public.$index.selectedForHandoff", selectedForHandoff(row.first, row.second.layer, Direction.FORWARD))
        }
        number("totalRows", total)
        flag("completeFrozenSummaryRows", true)
    }


    fun processedF3(result: RunResult<RunMethodAnalyzer>, fixture: DriverFixtures, root: MethodKey) = event("F3_PROCESSED_INPUT_HISTORY", fixture.manager) {
        check(result.runIndex == 3 && result.status == RunStatus.COMPLETE)
        val rows = fixture.processed.filter { it.run == result.runIndex && it.method == root }
        check(rows.size <= ROW_CAP)
        number("run", result.runIndex)
        text("method", root.toString())
        number("rowCount", rows.size)
        flag("scopeNotRecorded", true)
        flag("notAStoreAdmissionHistory", true)
        for ((index, row) in rows.withIndex()) {
            number("processed.$index.node", row.delta.node.location.index)
            premise("processed.$index.P", row.delta.premise)
            facts("processed.$index.F", row.delta.facts)
        }
    }
}

package org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.fixtures

import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.AccessPathBase
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.driver.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.CallPoint.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.StageKind.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.configuration.CommonTaintConfigurationSink
import org.opentaint.dataflow.configuration.CommonTaintConfigurationSinkMeta
import org.opentaint.ir.api.common.cfg.CommonInst
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedQueue
import kotlin.time.Duration
import kotlin.time.Duration.Companion.seconds

/** Select a fixture mode only while the production driver captures its immutable setting. */
internal fun <T> withRun1MarkMode(mode: MarkMode, body: () -> T): T {
    val property = "opentaint.bidi.run1MarkMode"
    val previous = System.getProperty(property)
    try {
        System.setProperty(property, mode.name)
        return body()
    } finally {
        if (previous == null) System.clearProperty(property) else System.setProperty(property, previous)
    }
}

data class ProgramCase(val root: MethodKey, val rule: RuleId, val sink: CommonInst, val source: PathEdge)
data class DriverInput(val run: Int, val callee: MethodKey, val link: Link)
data class DriverProcessed(val run: Int, val method: MethodKey, val delta: EdgeDelta)
data class DemandLinkCase(val root: MethodKey, val sourceMethod: MethodKey, val reader: MethodKey,
                          val sinkMethod: MethodKey, val rule: RuleId, val sink: CommonInst,
                          val source: PathEdge, val q: Int, val r: Int, val g: Int, val h: Int,
                          val mark: TaintMark)

/** Joined engine results are retained here only as explicit test observations. */
class DriverFixtures(threads: Int = 1) : AutoCloseable {
    val program = FiniteProgramFixtures(threads = threads)
    val shared get() = program.shared
    val manager get() = program.manager
    val ops get() = program.ops
    val records get() = program.records
    val vulnerabilities get() = program.vulnerabilities
    val cancellation get() = program.cancellation
    val refManager get() = program.refManager
    val configs = ArrayList<RunConfig>()
    val results = ArrayList<RunResult<RunMethodAnalyzer>>()
    val timeouts = ArrayList<Duration>()
    private val processRows = ConcurrentLinkedQueue<DriverProcessed>()
    private val inputRows = ConcurrentLinkedQueue<DriverInput>()
    fun links(run: Int, method: MethodKey): List<Link> = inputRows.filter { it.run == run && it.callee == method }.map { it.link }.distinct()
    val processed: List<DriverProcessed> get() = processRows.toList()

    fun manager(config: RunConfig, owner: SharedObjects = shared): RunManager<RunMethodAnalyzer> {
        val actual = RunMethodHandlers(MethodLocalServicesFactory(::RunMethodLocalServices),
            MethodCallServicesFactory(::RunMethodCallServices))
        val factory = RunnerHandlerFactory<RunMethodAnalyzer> { port ->
            val observed = object : RunnerPort<RunMethodAnalyzer> by port {
                // Restricted input stays in the caller. Observe eligible bindings
                // at subscription, not at the now-key-only callee packet.
                override fun subscribe(sub: Subscription) {
                    if (config.restricted && !sub.zeroOnly) ops.leaves(sub.added).forEach {
                        inputRows += DriverInput(config.index, sub.callee, Link(it, sub.linkLayer, sub.ref))
                    }
                    port.subscribe(sub)
                }
                override fun link(callee: MethodKey, ref: CallerRef, linkLayer: Layer, added: Facts) {
                    ops.leaves(added).forEach { inputRows += DriverInput(config.index, callee, Link(it, linkLayer, ref)) }
                    port.link(callee, ref, linkLayer, added)
                }
                override val onProcess: (MethodKey, EdgeDelta) -> Unit = { key, delta ->
                    processRows += DriverProcessed(config.index, key, delta)
                    port.onProcess?.invoke(key, delta)
                }
            }
            actual.create(observed)
        }
        return RunManager(config, owner, factory, quantum = 1)
    }

    fun run(config: RunConfig, owner: SharedObjects = shared,
            timeout: Duration = 5.seconds): RunResult<RunMethodAnalyzer> {
        configs += config
        timeouts += timeout
        return manager(config, owner).run(timeout).also(results::add)
    }

    fun driver(policy: IterationPolicy, budget: Duration = 5.seconds,
               invokeRun: (RunConfig, SharedObjects, Duration) -> RunResult<RunMethodAnalyzer> = this::run,
               run1MarkMode: MarkMode? = null,
               guardBarrier: (SharedObjects, () -> Next) -> Next = { _, body -> body() }): IterationDriver =
        if (run1MarkMode == null) IterationDriver(policy, shared, budget, invokeRun, guardBarrier)
        else withRun1MarkMode(run1MarkMode) { IterationDriver(policy, shared, budget, invokeRun, guardBarrier) }

    fun rule(id: String): RuleId = object : CommonTaintConfigurationSink {
        override val id = id
        override val meta = object : CommonTaintConfigurationSinkMeta {
            override val message = id
            override val severity = CommonTaintConfigurationSinkMeta.Severity.Warning
        }
    }

    fun summary(vararg edges: PathEdge): StatementSummary =
        StatementSummary(edges.map { it.from.base }.toSet(), edges.map(MicroEdge::of), emptyList(), emptyMap())

    private fun sourceRules(edge: PathEdge): RuleStatement =
        RuleStatement(summary(ZERO_KEEP, edge), StatementSummary.EMPTY, emptyList())

    private fun exitSink(sink: SinkRule): ExitRules =
        ExitRules(RuleStatement(StatementSummary.EMPTY, StatementSummary.EMPTY, listOf(sink)), false, emptySet())

    /** A normal root witness remains an unproved candidate under the minimal report policy. */
    fun confirmed(): ProgramCase {
        val root = program.method("confirmed", listOf(listOf(1), emptyList()), 1).key()
        val mark = MarkSlot.Concrete(program.mark("confirmed T"))
        val base = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(0)
        val source = PathEdge(ZERO_FACT, PathFact(base, emptyList(), Tail.EXACT, mark), ExclusionSet.Empty)
        val sink = SinkRule(rule("confirmed sink"), 0, listOf(program.pattern(base, mark = mark)), emptyList())
        program.entry(root, sourceRules(source))
        program.exit(root, 1, exitSink(sink))
        return ProgramCase(root, sink.rule, program.inst(root, 1), source)
    }

    /** The explicit may pass keeps this finding unconfirmed at every field limit. */
    fun persistentDemand(): ProgramCase {
        val root = program.method("persistent demand", listOf(listOf(1), listOf(2), emptyList()), 2).key()
        val mark = MarkSlot.Concrete(program.mark("persistent T"))
        val base = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(0)
        val source = PathEdge(ZERO_FACT, PathFact(base, emptyList(), Tail.EXACT, mark), ExclusionSet.Empty)
        val may = PathEdge(source.to, PathFact(AccessPathBase.Return, emptyList(), Tail.ANY, mark), ExclusionSet.Empty)
        val sink = SinkRule(rule("persistent sink"), 0,
            listOf(program.pattern(AccessPathBase.Return, tail = Tail.ANY, mark = mark)), emptyList())
        program.entry(root, sourceRules(source))
        program.statement(root, 1, summary(may))
        program.exit(root, 2, exitSink(sink))
        return ProgramCase(root, sink.rule, program.inst(root, 2), source)
    }

    /** A longer exact source is cut in run 1 and recovered by a real backward source hit. */
    fun refining(): ProgramCase {
        val root = program.method("refining", listOf(listOf(1), emptyList()), 1).key()
        val mark = MarkSlot.Concrete(program.mark("refining T"))
        val path = listOf(program.field("a"), program.field("b"))
        val source = PathEdge(ZERO_FACT, PathFact(AccessPathBase.Return, path, Tail.EXACT, mark), ExclusionSet.Empty)
        val sink = SinkRule(rule("refining sink"), 0, listOf(Pattern(source.to, ExclusionSet.Empty)), emptyList())
        program.entry(root, sourceRules(source))
        program.exit(root, 1, exitSink(sink))
        return ProgramCase(root, sink.rule, program.inst(root, 1), source)
    }

    /** Two different normal call sites cannot jointly support one callee conjunction. */
    fun unsupportedJoint(): ProgramCase {
        val root = program.method("separate sites", listOf(listOf(1), listOf(2), listOf(3), emptyList()), 3).key()
        val callee = program.method("joint sink", listOf(listOf(1), emptyList()), 1).key()
        val first = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(0)
        val second = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(1)
        val arg0 = AccessPathBase.Argument(0)
        val arg1 = AccessPathBase.Argument(1)
        val t = MarkSlot.Concrete(program.mark("joint T"))
        val u = MarkSlot.Concrete(program.mark("joint U"))
        val source = PathEdge(ZERO_FACT, PathFact(first, emptyList(), Tail.EXACT, t), ExclusionSet.Empty)
        val other = PathEdge(ZERO_FACT, PathFact(second, emptyList(), Tail.EXACT, u), ExclusionSet.Empty)
        val sink = SinkRule(rule("unsupported joint sink"), 0,
            listOf(program.pattern(arg0, mark = t), program.pattern(arg1, mark = u)), emptyList())
        program.entry(root, RuleStatement(summary(ZERO_KEEP, source, other), StatementSummary.EMPTY, emptyList()))
        fun call(value: AccessPathBase, argument: AccessPathBase) = CallPlan(setOf(value), listOf(
            CallStage.Edges(BEFORE, BOUND, BIND_IN, summary(starEdge(value, emptyList(), argument, emptyList()), ZERO_KEEP)),
            CallStage.Actions(BOUND, ADDED, emptyList()),
            CallStage.Callees(ADDED, RETURNED, listOf(callee)),
            CallStage.Actions(RETURNED, REWRITTEN, emptyList()),
            CallStage.Edges(REWRITTEN, AFTER, BIND_BACK, summary(ZERO_KEEP)),
        ), emptyList(), BEFORE, AFTER)
        program.call(root, 1, call(first, arg0))
        program.call(root, 2, call(second, arg1))
        program.exit(callee, 1, exitSink(sink))
        return ProgramCase(root, sink.rule, program.inst(callee, 1), source)
    }

    /** DLINK: srcAny; c(x) reads q then r; m cleans its root EXACT before the g.h sink and throws. */
    fun demandLink(): DemandLinkCase {
        val root = program.method("dlink root", listOf(listOf(1), listOf(2), listOf(3), emptyList()), 3).key()
        val sourceMethod = program.method("dlink srcAny", listOf(listOf(1), emptyList()), 1).key()
        val reader = program.method("dlink c", listOf(listOf(1), listOf(2), listOf(3), listOf(4), emptyList()), 4).key()
        // The normal exit is unreachable. Reached requirements and the sink flow through the exceptional exit.
        val sinkMethod = program.method("dlink m", listOf(listOf(1), listOf(2), emptyList(), emptyList()),
            normalExit = 3, exceptionalExit = 2).key()
        val dto = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(0)
        val temporary = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(1)
        val value = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(2)
        val argument = AccessPathBase.Argument(0)
        val returned = AccessPathBase.Return
        val q = program.field("q")
        val r = program.field("r")
        val g = program.field("g")
        val h = program.field("h")
        val taint = program.mark("DLINK T")
        val mark = MarkSlot.Concrete(taint)
        val source = PathEdge(ZERO_FACT, PathFact(returned, emptyList(), Tail.ANY_TAINT, mark), ExclusionSet.Empty)
        program.entry(sourceMethod, sourceRules(source))
        fun resolved(callee: MethodKey, bindIn: StatementSummary, bindBack: StatementSummary,
                     touched: Set<AccessPathBase>, cleaner: Cleaner? = null): CallPlan = CallPlan(touched, listOf(
            CallStage.Edges(BEFORE, BOUND, BIND_IN, bindIn),
            CallStage.Actions(BOUND, ADDED, cleaner?.let { listOf(CleanStep.Clean(it)) }.orEmpty()),
            CallStage.Callees(ADDED, RETURNED, listOf(callee)),
            CallStage.Actions(RETURNED, REWRITTEN, emptyList()),
            CallStage.Edges(REWRITTEN, AFTER, BIND_BACK, bindBack),
        ), emptyList(), BEFORE, AFTER)
        program.call(root, 1, resolved(sourceMethod, summary(ZERO_KEEP),
            summary(starEdge(returned, emptyList(), dto, emptyList()), ZERO_KEEP), setOf(dto)))
        program.call(root, 2, resolved(reader, summary(starEdge(dto, emptyList(), argument, emptyList()), ZERO_KEEP),
            summary(ZERO_KEEP), setOf(dto)))
        program.statement(reader, 1, StatementSummary(setOf(argument, temporary),
            listOf(MicroEdge.of(keepEdge(argument)), MicroEdge.of(starEdge(argument, listOf(q), temporary, emptyList()))),
            emptyList(), emptyMap()))
        program.statement(reader, 2, StatementSummary(setOf(temporary, value),
            listOf(MicroEdge.of(keepEdge(temporary)), MicroEdge.of(starEdge(temporary, listOf(r), value, emptyList()))),
            emptyList(), emptyMap()))
        program.call(reader, 3, resolved(sinkMethod, summary(starEdge(value, emptyList(), argument, emptyList()), ZERO_KEEP),
            summary(ZERO_KEEP), setOf(value), Cleaner(argument, null, CleanReach.EXACT, taint)))
        val sink = SinkRule(rule("DLINK sink"), 0, listOf(program.pattern(argument, listOf(g, h), mark = mark)), emptyList())
        program.call(sinkMethod, 1, CallPlan(setOf(argument), listOf(
            CallStage.Edges(BEFORE, BOUND, BIND_IN, summary(keepEdge(argument), ZERO_KEEP)),
            CallStage.Actions(BOUND, ADDED, emptyList()),
            CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, UNRESOLVED, summary(keepEdge(argument), ZERO_KEEP)),
            CallStage.Actions(RETURNED, REWRITTEN, emptyList()),
            CallStage.Edges(REWRITTEN, AFTER, BIND_BACK, summary(keepEdge(argument), ZERO_KEEP)),
        ), listOf(sink), BEFORE, AFTER))
        return DemandLinkCase(root, sourceMethod, reader, sinkMethod, sink.rule, program.inst(sinkMethod, 1),
            source, q, r, g, h, taint)
    }

    override fun close(): Unit = program.close()
}

proof/NormalStarFlowAdmissionGap.lean.text:
/-
Counterexample only. The existing C2 cell rejects same-head ANY demand with a
supplied NORMAL STAR/FLOW value. A typed NORMAL STAR/FLOW read relation can still
transport its suffix, including an exact full-T caller with empty suffix.
No admission change, termination result or program recovery is selected/proved.
Scope: ordinary bases, counted fields, Empty E, FULL scalar marks, no MUST.
-/
import RestrictedInitialPolicy

namespace NormalStarFlowAdmissionGap
open ApSpec
abbrev Input := RestrictedInitialPolicy.Input
abbrev Demand := RestrictedInitialPolicy.Demand

inductive Layer where | normal | demand
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
structure Actual where
  fact : Input
  layer : Layer
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def starFlow (base : Nat) (path : List Acc) : Input := ⟨base,path,.star,.flow,false⟩
def anyFlowDemand (base : Nat) (path : List Acc) : Demand := ⟨base,path,.any,.flow⟩

theorem current_C2_same_head_ANY_STAR_FLOW_rejects
    (base : Nat) (field : Acc) (rest : List Acc) :
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit (anyFlowDemand base (field :: rest))
      (starFlow base (field :: rest)) = none := by
  have same : dropPrefix (field :: rest) (field :: rest) = some [] :=
    ApSpec.Handoff.RAux.dropPrefix_self' (field :: rest)
  simp [RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit,RestrictedInitialPolicy.selectTemplate,
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.rawTemplate,RestrictedInitialPolicy.validInput,
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.acceptsMark,RestrictedInitialPolicy.shapeEq,
    anyFlowDemand,starFlow,relate,same]

theorem supplied_STAR_FLOW_is_not_MUST (base : Nat) (field : Acc) (rest : List Acc) :
    (starFlow base (field :: rest)).shape = .star ∧
    (starFlow base (field :: rest)).mark = .flow ∧
    (starFlow base (field :: rest)).must = false ∧
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.validInput (starFlow base (field :: rest)) = true := by
  exact ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl⟩

/-- The transfer type fixes the stored entry/result heads to STAR/FLOW/NORMAL.
Its entry path is nonempty. It does not assert that C2 admitted this entry. -/
structure NormalStarRead where
  sourceBase : Nat
  resultBase : Nat
  field : Acc
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
def entry (read : NormalStarRead) : Actual := ⟨starFlow read.sourceBase [read.field],.normal⟩
def summary (read : NormalStarRead) : Actual := ⟨starFlow read.resultBase [],.normal⟩

def applyRead (read : NormalStarRead) (actual : Actual) : Option Actual :=
  if Nat.beq read.sourceBase actual.fact.base then
    (dropPrefix [read.field] actual.fact.path).map (fun suffix =>
      ⟨{ actual.fact with base := read.resultBase,path := suffix },actual.layer⟩)
  else none

theorem normal_STAR_FLOW_relation_has_nonempty_entry (read : NormalStarRead) :
    (entry read).fact.path = [read.field] ∧
    (entry read).fact.shape = .star ∧ (entry read).fact.mark = .flow ∧
    (summary read).fact.shape = .star ∧ (summary read).fact.mark = .flow ∧
    (entry read).layer = .normal ∧ (summary read).layer = .normal := by
  exact ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl⟩

/-- Structural suffix law for this NORMAL, non-MUST typed read adapter.
Mark and shape come from the actual; no concrete mark is manufactured. -/
theorem suffix_transport (read : NormalStarRead) (suffix : List Acc)
    (shape : RestrictedInitialPolicy.Shape) (mark : RestrictedInitialPolicy.Mark) :
    applyRead read ⟨⟨read.sourceBase,[read.field] ++ suffix,shape,mark,false⟩,.normal⟩ =
      some ⟨⟨read.resultBase,suffix,shape,mark,false⟩,.normal⟩ := by
  have prefixEquation : dropPrefix [read.field] ([read.field] ++ suffix) = some suffix :=
    CoreAux.dropPrefix_some.mpr rfl
  simp only [applyRead, Nat.beq_refl, if_true, prefixEquation, Option.map_some]

theorem universal_normal_STAR_FLOW_to_ret_STAR_FLOW_suffix
    (read : NormalStarRead) (suffix : List Acc) :
    applyRead read ⟨starFlow read.sourceBase ([read.field] ++ suffix),.normal⟩ =
      some ⟨starFlow read.resultBase suffix,.normal⟩ :=
  suffix_transport read suffix .star .flow

theorem universal_normal_exact_T_suffix (read : NormalStarRead) (suffix : List Acc) (t : Nat) :
    applyRead read ⟨⟨read.sourceBase,[read.field] ++ suffix,.exact,.full t,false⟩,.normal⟩ =
      some ⟨⟨read.resultBase,suffix,.exact,.full t,false⟩,.normal⟩ :=
  suffix_transport read suffix .exact (.full t)

def composeReads (first second : NormalStarRead) (actual : Actual) : Option Actual :=
  (applyRead first actual).bind (applyRead second)

theorem two_getters_transport_every_normal_exact_T_suffix
    (arg gotF ret : Nat) (f g : Acc) (suffix : List Acc) (t : Nat) :
    composeReads ⟨arg,gotF,f⟩ ⟨gotF,ret,g⟩
      ⟨⟨arg,[f,g] ++ suffix,.exact,.full t,false⟩,.normal⟩ =
      some ⟨⟨ret,suffix,.exact,.full t,false⟩,.normal⟩ := by
  unfold composeReads
  have first := universal_normal_exact_T_suffix ⟨arg,gotF,f⟩ ([g] ++ suffix) t
  have second := universal_normal_exact_T_suffix ⟨gotF,ret,g⟩ suffix t
  have firstAtCaller : applyRead ⟨arg,gotF,f⟩
      ⟨⟨arg,[f,g] ++ suffix,.exact,.full t,false⟩,.normal⟩ =
      some ⟨⟨gotF,[g] ++ suffix,.exact,.full t,false⟩,.normal⟩ := by
    simpa only [List.cons_append,List.nil_append] using first
  rw [firstAtCaller]
  exact second

def arg : Nat := 1
def gotF : Nat := 2
def ret : Nat := 3
def f : Acc := 7
def g : Acc := 8
def T : Nat := 11
def getF : NormalStarRead := ⟨arg,gotF,f⟩
def getG : NormalStarRead := ⟨gotF,ret,g⟩

theorem existing_run3_policy_rejects_frozen_getG_cell :
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy.decisionForRun 3 (anyFlowDemand gotF [g])
      (starFlow gotF [g]) = .decided none := by decide

theorem rejected_metadata_still_has_NORMAL_STAR_FLOW_read_image :
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit (anyFlowDemand gotF [g]) (starFlow gotF [g]) = none ∧
    applyRead getG ⟨starFlow gotF [g],.normal⟩ = some ⟨starFlow ret [],.normal⟩ := by decide

theorem concrete_empty_suffix_survives_both_normal_getters :
    composeReads getF getG ⟨⟨arg,[f,g],.exact,.full T,false⟩,.normal⟩ =
      some ⟨⟨ret,[],.exact,.full T,false⟩,.normal⟩ := by decide

theorem a_different_first_field_is_not_transferred :
    applyRead getG ⟨⟨gotF,[f],.exact,.full T,false⟩,.normal⟩ = none := by decide

def witness : Bool :=
  decide (RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit (anyFlowDemand gotF [g]) (starFlow gotF [g]) = none) &&
  decide (composeReads getF getG ⟨⟨arg,[f,g],.exact,.full T,false⟩,.normal⟩ =
    some ⟨⟨ret,[],.exact,.full T,false⟩,.normal⟩)
theorem executable_gap_witness : witness = true := by decide
#eval (if witness then "NORMAL_STAR_FLOW_GAP=true" else "NORMAL_STAR_FLOW_GAP=false")

-- One audit command per theorem.
#print axioms current_C2_same_head_ANY_STAR_FLOW_rejects
#print axioms supplied_STAR_FLOW_is_not_MUST
#print axioms normal_STAR_FLOW_relation_has_nonempty_entry
#print axioms suffix_transport
#print axioms universal_normal_STAR_FLOW_to_ret_STAR_FLOW_suffix
#print axioms universal_normal_exact_T_suffix
#print axioms two_getters_transport_every_normal_exact_T_suffix
#print axioms existing_run3_policy_rejects_frozen_getG_cell
#print axioms rejected_metadata_still_has_NORMAL_STAR_FLOW_read_image
#print axioms concrete_empty_suffix_survives_both_normal_getters
#print axioms a_different_first_field_is_not_transferred
#print axioms executable_gap_witness

end NormalStarFlowAdmissionGap

decision/decision-audit.md.text:
# Nonempty same-path STAR/FLOW admission: decision audit

READ ONLY. No policy is selected here. No production/test edits, Lean check,
native job, project launch or AP query/interner call was performed. This is
a source-evaluated local counterexample, not new runtime evidence.

## Result

A nonempty path does not itself make repeated ANY-to-STAR/FLOW admission a
refinement step. The original OWASP local ancestor-read cycle can be placed
under one ordinary field k. If a NORMAL p.k.STAR/FLOW packet is supplied on
each forward round, the proposed same-path exception reopens exactly that
query and regenerates p.k.ANY/FLOW demand. No growing field chain is needed.
Restricting the exception to NORMAL supplied packets does not block this
local cycle: only its forward admission needs the new cell; the backward
step can use the existing ANY-with-ANY DEMAND admission.

This does NOT show that the existing OwaspDemandCycleTest would fail under
the proposed exception. Its later forward boundary input is a concrete
whole-object MUST/T at the empty path. It is neither the proposed nonempty
STAR/FLOW packet nor a proof that a caller will resupply such a packet in
every later round. A full native prefixed/caller test is still required.

## What the existing test and original rationale establish

`OwaspDemandCycleTest.kt:14-28` describes a getBytes/newString model. Its
supplied edges all have STAR tails; the AP read below an ancestor creates
ANY/DEMAND. Lines 67-74 install the root-copy and H-storage alternatives.
The source is concrete MUST/T, not FLOW STAR (lines 48-50). The current test
expects complete runs 1,2,3, no final demand, one sink and no root STAR/FLOW
reopening at run3 (85-110).

The historical investigation `bidirectional-initial-emission-refinement-20261029.md`
sections 3-4 records the old repeated root query and explains why NORMAL
records do not certify that every relation under an initial has completed.
Its section 8 explicitly limits the Lean recurrence: boundary packets are
supplied afresh; it does not derive them from the full caller/record state.
`Cycle.lean:1-19` repeats that limitation, and its local `computed_round_fixed`,
`recurring_demand` and bounded-schedule laws check that old local recurrence.

The later one-step policy rejects same-path STAR actuals for ANY demand and
emits STAR only after learning a new field. Its source comments also say
unchanged ANY is valid; a blanket strict-progress rule is not selected.
Thus neither “all equal-path inputs are bad” nor “a nonempty equal path must
be useful” follows from the original rationale.

## Source-bound translated helper

Use ordinary bases p=Argument(0), b/o=locals, ret=Return; distinct counted
fields k and H; empty E and mx; no protection, ND, statics, cleaners or rules.
One fixed helper/method/context and ROOT scope owns every row. Every supplied
edge is legal STAR/FLOW to STAR/FLOW:

```text
p.k.*     / FLOW -> b.k.*     / FLOW
p.k.H.*   / FLOW -> b.k.*     / FLOW
b.k.*     / FLOW -> o.k.*     / FLOW
b.k.*     / FLOW -> o.k.H.*   / FLOW
o.k.*     / FLOW -> ret.k.*   / FLOW
```

Code shape under analysis:

```java
helper(p) {
    bytes.k = modelGetBytes(p.k);
    out.k = modelNewString(bytes.k);
    return out;
}
// modelGetBytes offers both copy and H-storage read routes.
// modelNewString offers both copy and H-storage write routes.
```

This prefixes the original local model by k; it is not a new executed Java
fixture. `EdgeApplication.flow:83-94` converts a STAR leaf above p.k.H into
ANY/DEMAND at b.k. Its equal-node STAR branch preserves the ordinary copy
route (98-112). `Reference.kt:297-318` supplies the scalar version of that
ancestor-loss rule. Nothing in that rule treats the base root specially.

Starting p.k.STAR/FLOW NORMAL therefore gives the same four alternatives as
the original Cycle.lean, translated by k:

```text
ret.k.STAR/FLOW NORMAL
ret.k.H.STAR/FLOW NORMAL
ret.k.ANY/FLOW DEMAND
ret.k.H.ANY/FLOW DEMAND
```

Old compaction may remove the finer ANY child; current guide retention may
keep it. Both retain the coarse ret.k.ANY demand needed below.

## Exact local two-round recurrence

Write a demand pair as `(entry -> paired exit)`. All paired labels remain
with this helper; no Target row, zero exit or other method is borrowed.

Forward demand:

```text
DF = (p.k.ANY/FLOW -> ret.k.ANY/FLOW)
supplied AF = p.k.STAR/FLOW NORMAL
```

Current C2 rejects AF at `RestrictedInitialPolicy.kt:30-35`. Under the
candidate nonempty NORMAL STAR/FLOW cell, C2 emits:

```text
IF = p.k.STAR/FLOW, admitted NORMAL
```

FLOW STAR is intrinsically NORMAL (`AdmittedInitial.kt:9-15`,
`Demand.kt:10-16`), without changing any layer rule. The translated helper
produces ret.k.ANY/FLOW DEMAND as above. The paired exit is at that same path,
so ordinary C5 keeps the ANY result. Handoff yields:

```text
DB = (ret.k.ANY/FLOW -> p.k.STAR/FLOW)
```

Now supply an ordinary backward requirement, as in the old source/sink
mechanism, for example:

```text
AB = ret.k.ANY/T DEMAND
```

Existing C2 already emits `IB=ret.k.ANY/FLOW DEMAND` from DB+AB. No new
backward STAR exception is used. Reverse the five model edges. An ANY leaf
at ret.k stays ANY/DEMAND through the return/copy/storage alternatives and
produces `p.k.ANY/FLOW DEMAND` (plus possible p.k.H.ANY). C5 keeps it under
DB's paired p.k.STAR exit: same-path ANY intersect STAR remains ANY in
`Reference.meetConclusion:222-228`. Handoff then returns exactly:

```text
(p.k.ANY/FLOW -> ret.k.ANY/FLOW) = DF
```

Therefore DF plus the same supplied AF/AB repeats the local selected-demand
work. AF has NORMAL layer as required by the candidate; AB uses an existing
DEMAND ANY cell. The recurrence is conditional on those supplied packets,
just like the original local Lean cycle model.

All intermediate paths have at most two counted fields (k or k.H). For every
field budget at least 2, cuts cannot eliminate this local pattern. A path
nonempty test, or the condition known-prefix-depth < current budget, does
not force it to advance past k in the next round.

## C5/image and records are not automatic guards

A coherent admission extension must audit the raw output image:
`canEmitInitial` currently excludes raw same-path STAR for ANY (lines 80-86).
But `canStoreInitial:95-100` already permits normalized stored STAR/FLOW via
its EXACT preimage. Thus current summary storage is not an independent
blocker for this example. Entry containment accepts STAR under same-path
ANY. The B initial ANY is already in the current image.

The proposed cell's raw-image correction is an implementation obligation;
leaving an inconsistent image function is not a termination argument.

NORMAL copy/storage records can coexist with the ANY demand result. They
establish their own suffix relations, not completion of every output or
observation under IF. Restricted C2 has no completed-initial history check.
The current call service obtains restricted initials from demand independently
of any general proof that records close that initial. Do not assume record
reuse suppresses the local DEMAND cycle.

## Packet supply: plausible source, not a whole-driver proof

NORMAL nonempty STAR/FLOW is legal and is not hypothetical taint truth. The
existing first-new-field C2 rule already emits it: outer root ANY/FLOW plus
actual exact T at k.s emits k.STAR/FLOW (policy lines 40-48), and FLOW starts
NORMAL. A root-to-root binding into a nested call preserves suffix k. A
NORMAL record can also supply a STAR/FLOW actual. These are source routes
to the proposed packet class, not a proof they recur in this exact helper.

An outer demand may refine, a caller may cease supplying AF, or a different
normal relation may close the needed observation. The full driver can then
stop despite this local recurrence. Conversely, nonempty eligibility alone
provides no certificate that any such progress happens. No complete-driver
nontermination or Conductor finding consequence is established here.

## Decision evidence still needed

Keep the current root OWASP test as a control. A mere prefix change to its
whole-object source is insufficient: that still supplies MUST/T, not the
candidate STAR/FLOW cell. A useful future native test must establish actual
nonempty NORMAL STAR/FLOW supply, complete paired DF/DB rows, returned C2
initials, processed work and final demand across more than one round. Add
the no-storage-route control, increasing limits >=2, and correct raw-image
and normalized-storage checks. Root owns any such jobs; none were run here.

Guidance-only repair is not selected or proved by this audit either. It
must identify the missing child guide and show the required source/normal
effect under existing C2; abstract inclusion alone does not establish that.
The audit supports a narrow conclusion: admitting this cell at every later
iteration can reopen the old local mechanism under a concrete prefix, and
“nonempty NORMAL” is not a sufficient convergence justification.
